    13	the split): the two junctions are mutually inverse `R`-linear maps, and the rigid
    14	engine's outputs transport across the resulting equivalence.
    15	
    16	* `DivisorAdaptation.gluedToVanishingₗ` — the forward junction as an `R`-linear map
    17	  (`gluedToIdeal₀/₁` are additive and `R`-homogeneous by uniqueness of assemblies);
    18	* `DivisorAdaptation.gluedEquivVanishing` — **the junction equivalence**
    19	  `F_{Θᵃ−d}(⊤) ≃ₗ[R] K_a(d)` (mutually inverse by uniqueness of cofactors);
    20	* `DivisorAdaptation.datumH0EquivVanishing` — the engine's `H⁰`-carrier form
    21	  `H⁰(C_R, F_{Θᵃ−d}) ≃ₗ[R] K_a(d)`;
    22	* `DivisorAdaptation.finite_vanishingSubmodule` / `projective_vanishingSubmodule` —
    23	  **the certificate transport, first output** (`informal/spec-dd-r.md` §3 item 4): over
    24	  a Noetherian test ring, given the complex-form fibrewise `h¹`-data of the theta-ideal
    25	  datum (the P-fib fibrewise boundary, same shape as `thetaGluedEval_surjective`), the
    26	  vanishing submodule `K_a(d)` is a finite projective `R`-module — the engine fired on
    27	  the constructed family's twisted glued sheaf (`datumRigidEngine`), transported along
    28	  the junction;

    31	  `K_a(d) ⊆ R ⊗[k] H_a` of `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyWindow` (the
    32	  `grFunctorAff`-ambient carrier that DDR-5/DDR-9 consume).

    34	ANTI-CIRCULARITY (binding, spec §3 item 4): the fibrewise inputs are hypotheses on the
    35	CARVE-PAIR side (P-fib on fibres of the universal pair, certificate-free); the engine
    36	UPGRADES them; `IsCertified` clauses are OUTPUTS — nothing here assumes a certificate.

    12	# The universal-family certificate assembly
    13	
    14	This file assembles the seven fields of `DivisorAdaptation.IsCertified` from the
    15	geometric inputs left by the universal-seed construction:
    16	
    17	* finite chart colengths, supplied by the no-leak theorem in `SupportTubeFinite`;
    18	* fibrewise regular chart equations, which make those colengths projective;
    19	* a relative submodule spanning the residue-fibre kernels of the Cech difference map;
    20	* the fibre dimension of that kernel.
    21	
    22	The last two inputs feed `SlicingFlatKernel`, simultaneously producing the projective
    23	glued module, its constant rank, and both flat-cokernel clauses.  Keeping this assembly
    24	generic isolates the remaining DD-4 geometry from the certificate bookkeeping.
    25	-/

    47	/-- Assemble a divisor-family certificate from finite regular chart colengths and a

    50	The overlap product is kept as an explicit finite-flat input: producing it from the
    51	universal seed is part of the geometric base-change wiring, while all consequences for
    52	the certificate are discharged here. -/
    53	theorem isCertified_of_kernel_spanning [IsNoetherianRing R] {n : Nat}
    54	    (hfin : forall j : A.index, Module.Finite R (A.colength j))
    55	    (hregular : forall (j : A.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum R),
    56	      (A.eqn j ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    57	          Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ∈
    58	        nonZeroDivisors
    59	          (Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
    60	    (hovlFinite : Module.Finite R A.ovlProd)
    61	    (hovlFlat : Module.Flat R A.ovlProd)
    62	    (L : Submodule R A.chartProd)
    63	    (hle : L <= LinearMap.ker (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))
    64	    (hspan : forall p : PrimeSpectrum R,
    65	      LinearMap.ker ((A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField) <=
    66	        LinearMap.range (L.subtype.rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
    67	    (hdim : forall p : PrimeSpectrum R,
    68	      Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
    69	          (LinearMap.ker
    70	            ((A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight).baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) = n) :
    71	    A.IsCertified n := by
    72	  letI hfiniteColength : forall j : A.index, Module.Finite R (A.colength j) := hfin
    73	  letI hprojectiveColength : forall j : A.index, Module.Projective R (A.colength j) :=
    74	    fun j => A.projective_colength_of_forall_tmul_residueField j (hregular j)
    75	  letI hflatColength : forall j : A.index, Module.Flat R (A.colength j) :=
    76	    fun j => A.flat_colength_of_forall_tmul_residueField j (hregular j)
    77	  letI hfiniteChart : Module.Finite R A.chartProd := Module.Finite.pi
    78	  letI hflatChart : Module.Flat R A.chartProd := Module.Flat.pi_of_finite
    79	  letI hfiniteOvl : Module.Finite R A.ovlProd := hovlFinite
    80	  letI hflatOvl : Module.Flat R A.ovlProd := hovlFlat
    81	  have hfiniteGlued : Module.Finite R A.Glued :=
    82	    Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr (_root_.IsNoetherian.noetherian A.gluedSubmodule)
    83	  have hprojectiveGlued : Module.Projective R A.Glued :=
    84	    Module.Projective.ker_of_forall_ker_rTensor_residueField_le
    85	      (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) L hle hspan

    88	      projective_colength := fun j => hprojectiveColength j
    89	      finite_glued := hfiniteGlued
    90	      projective_glued := hprojectiveGlued
    91	      rankAtStalk_glued := fun p =>
    92	        Module.rankAtStalk_ker_eq_of_forall_finrank_eq
    93	          (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) L hle hspan n hdim p

    95	        Module.Flat.quotient_ker_of_forall_ker_rTensor_residueField_le
    96	          (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) L hle hspan
    97	      flat_coker_diff :=
    98	        Module.Flat.quotient_range_of_forall_ker_rTensor_residueField_le
    99	          (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) L hle hspan }

   108	        (A.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)))
   109	    (hregular : forall (j : A.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum R),
   110	      (A.eqn j ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   111	          Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ∈
   112	        nonZeroDivisors
   113	          (Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
   114	    (hovlFinite : Module.Finite R A.ovlProd)
   115	    (hovlFlat : Module.Flat R A.ovlProd)
   116	    (L : Submodule R A.chartProd)
   117	    (hle : L <= LinearMap.ker (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight))
   118	    (hspan : forall p : PrimeSpectrum R,
   119	      LinearMap.ker ((A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField) <=
   120	        LinearMap.range (L.subtype.rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
   121	    (hdim : forall p : PrimeSpectrum R,
   122	      Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   123	          (LinearMap.ker
   124	            ((A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight).baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) = n) :
   125	    A.IsCertified n :=
   126	  A.isCertified_of_kernel_spanning
   127	    (fun j => A.finite_colength_of_forall_fibre_closure_subset j (hnoLeak j))
   128	    hregular hovlFinite hovlFlat L hle hspan hdim
   129	
   130	end DivisorAdaptation

   134	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsProper C.hom]
   135	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
   136	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
   137	variable {a n : Nat} {K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R pi a)}
   138	variable {D : ThetaGeneratorSeed C R pi a K}
   139	
   140	/-- Assemble the certificate of the adaptation extracted from a theta-generator seed.
   141	Seed regularity supplies both chart regularity and overlap flatness, while no-leak
   142	supplies both chart and overlap finiteness.  Thus only no-leak, relative kernel
   143	spanning, and the fibre dimension remain as substantive inputs. -/
   144	theorem divisorAdaptation_isCertified_of_noLeak_kernel_spanning
   145	    (hD : D.IsGenerator)
   146	    (hnoLeak : forall (j : (D.divisorAdaptation hD).index) (s : Spec (.of R)),
   147	      ((relCurve C R) ↘ Spec (.of R)).base ⁻¹' {s}
   148	          ∩ closure
   149	            ((D.localEquations hD).supportLocus ∩
   150	              ((D.divisorAdaptation hD).pieces j : Set (relCurve C R))) ⊆
   151	        ((D.divisorAdaptation hD).pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)))
   152	    (L : Submodule R (D.divisorAdaptation hD).chartProd)
   153	    (hle : L ≤ LinearMap.ker
   154	      ((D.divisorAdaptation hD).deltaLeft - (D.divisorAdaptation hD).deltaRight))
   155	    (hspan : forall p : PrimeSpectrum R,
   156	      LinearMap.ker
   157	          (((D.divisorAdaptation hD).deltaLeft -
   158	            (D.divisorAdaptation hD).deltaRight).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≤
   159	        LinearMap.range (L.subtype.rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
   160	    (hdim : forall p : PrimeSpectrum R,
   161	      Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   162	          (LinearMap.ker
   163	            (((D.divisorAdaptation hD).deltaLeft -
   164	              (D.divisorAdaptation hD).deltaRight).baseChange
   165	                p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) = n) :
   166	    (D.divisorAdaptation hD).IsCertified n :=
   167	  (D.divisorAdaptation hD).isCertified_of_noLeak_kernel_spanning
   168	    hnoLeak
   169	    (D.divisorAdaptation_fibre_regular hD)
   170	    ((D.divisorAdaptation hD).finite_ovlProd_of_noLeak hnoLeak)
   171	    ((D.divisorAdaptation hD).flat_ovlProd_of_seed hD)
   172	    L hle hspan hdim
   173	
   174	end ThetaGeneratorSeed

    10	/-!
    11	# DDR-4 (certificate transport) — the window–engine junction `H⁰(𝒪(Θᵃ − d)) ≅ K_a(d)`
    12	
    13	THE seam brick of the DD-R endgame (`informal/spec-dd-r.md` §3 item 4, probe verdict
    14	GREEN): the bridge between DD-1's `gluedSubmodule`-style carriers and the rigid engine's
    15	Čech `H⁰` of the constructed family's twisted glued sheaf.  For a divisor family `d`
    16	with finite chart adaptation `A` on the relative curve `C_R` and a twist exponent `a`,
    17	the global sections of the theta-ideal datum sheaf (`DivisorAdaptation.thetaIdealDatum`,
    18	the engine-ready presentation of `𝒪(Θᵃ − d)`) are identified `R`-linearly with the
    19	vanishing submodule `K_a(d) = H⁰(𝒪(Θᵃ − d)) ⊆ H⁰(𝒪(Θᵃ))`:
    20	
    21	* `DivisorAdaptation.vanishingSide` / `vanishingDiv` — a global twisted pair vanishing
    22	  along `d`, read on the piece `D(h_p)` through its pinned-chart side, and its unique
    23	  cofactor over the adaptation equation `f_p`;
    24	* `DivisorAdaptation.vanishingToGlued` — **the backward junction**: the cofactor family
    25	  is a matched family of the theta-ideal datum (transition units `(f_q/f_p)·θ^{±a}`) —
    26	  a global section of the datum sheaf, with NO sheaf gluing (datum sections are
    27	  definitionally matched families);
    28	* `DivisorAdaptation.gluedVanishingFst/Snd`, `gluedToVanishing` — **the forward
    29	  junction**: the two chart assemblies `gluedToIdeal₀/₁` of a global datum section form
    30	  a twisted pair vanishing along `d`.
    31	
    32	The junction equivalence `gluedEquivVanishing`/`datumH0EquivVanishing` (mutually
    33	inverse by uniqueness of cofactors) and the engine transport (`datumRigidEngine` ⟹
    34	`K_a(d)`/`divisorWindow` finite projective over a Noetherian test ring, given the
    35	fibrewise `h¹`-data of the theta-ideal datum) are in
    36	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeCertificateEngine` (the 500-line cap).
    37	
    38	Everything is stated for an arbitrary adaptation, so the DDR-3 universal family
    39	(`ThetaGeneratorSeed.divisorAdaptation`) and DD-4's Task-4 residual both consume it.
    40	-/

    52

    60	
    61	/-- Restriction of scheme sections commutes with the `Scheme.overModule` action. -/
    62	private lemma resHom_smul {V W : (relCurve C R).Opens} (h : V ≤ W) (r : R)
    63	    (s : Γ(relCurve C R, W)) :
    64	    (relCurve C R).resHom h (r • s) = r • (relCurve C R).resHom h s := by
    65	  rw [Scheme.overModule_smul_def, map_mul, Scheme.overModule_smul_def]
    66	  congr 1
    67	  exact (relCurve C R).overAlgebraMap_apply_res R (homOfLE h).op r

    69	/-! ## The backward junction: from a vanishing pair to a global datum section -/
    70	
    71	section Backward
    72	
    73	variable (x : ↥(d.vanishingSubmodule R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
    74	    (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a)))
    75	
    76	variable (A a) in
    77	/-- **The side reading of a vanishing pair on a piece**: the pinned-chart component of
    78	the pair on the part of the chart cut by `⊤ ⊓ D(h_p)`. -/
    79	noncomputable def vanishingSide : ∀ p : A.index, Γ(relCurve C R, ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces p)
    80	  | Sum.inl i => (relCurve C R).resHom
    81	      (inf_le_inf le_rfl (A.pieces_inl_le i)) x.1.1.1
    82	  | Sum.inr j => (relCurve C R).resHom
    83	      (inf_le_inf le_rfl (A.pieces_inr_le j)) x.1.1.2
    84	
    85	@[simp]
    86	lemma vanishingSide_inl (i : Fin A.m₀) :
    87	    vanishingSide A a x (Sum.inl i)
    88	      = (relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_inf le_rfl (A.pieces_inl_le i)) x.1.1.1 := rfl
    89	
    90	@[simp]
    91	lemma vanishingSide_inr (j : Fin A.m₁) :
    92	    vanishingSide A a x (Sum.inr j)
    93	      = (relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_inf le_rfl (A.pieces_inr_le j)) x.1.1.2 := rfl
    94	
    95	/-- The side readings vanish along `d` germwise. -/
    96	lemma vanishingSide_germ_mem (p : A.index) :
    97	    ∀ (z : relCurve C R) (hz : z ∈ (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces p : (relCurve C R).Opens)),
    98	      ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces p) z hz).hom
    99	        (vanishingSide A a x p) ∈ d.stalkIdeal z := by
   100	  rcases p with i | j
   101	  · intro z hz
   102	    have hswap : ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i)) z hz).hom
   103	        ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_inf le_rfl (A.pieces_inl_le i)) x.1.1.1)
   104	        = ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ
   105	            (⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀) z
   106	            ⟨trivial, A.pieces_inl_le i hz.2⟩).hom x.1.1.1 :=
   107	      TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
   108	    rw [vanishingSide_inl, hswap]
   109	    exact x.2.1 z _
   110	  · intro z hz
   111	    have hswap : ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j)) z hz).hom
   112	        ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_inf le_rfl (A.pieces_inr_le j)) x.1.1.2)
   113	        = ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ
   114	            (⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁) z
   115	            ⟨trivial, A.pieces_inr_le j hz.2⟩).hom x.1.1.2 :=
   116	      TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
   117	    rw [vanishingSide_inr, hswap]
   118	    exact x.2.2 z _
   119	
   120	/-- **The side matching**: on the double overlap `⊤ ⊓ D(h_p) ⊓ D(h_q)` the side
   121	readings match through the theta twisting unit of the pair — same-chart pairs on the
   122	nose, cross-chart pairs through the (inverse) theta cocycle, exactly the twisted-pair
   123	matching of the underlying global section. -/
   124	lemma vanishingSide_matching (p q : A.index) :
   125	    (relCurve C R).resHom
   126	        (le_inf le_top (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) :
   127	          (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces p ⊓ A.pieces q : (relCurve C R).Opens) ≤ ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces p)
   128	        (vanishingSide A a x p)
   129	      = (relCurve C R).resHom
   130	          (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right :
   131	            (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces p ⊓ A.pieces q : (relCurve C R).Opens)
   132	              ≤ A.pieces p ⊓ A.pieces q)
   133	          ((A.thetaOvlUnit a p q : Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces p ⊓ A.pieces q)ˣ) :
   134	            Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces p ⊓ A.pieces q))
   135	        * (relCurve C R).resHom
   136	            (le_inf le_top inf_le_right :
   137	              (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces p ⊓ A.pieces q : (relCurve C R).Opens) ≤ ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces q)
   138	            (vanishingSide A a x q) := by
   139	  -- the twisted matching of the underlying pair, restricted to the double overlap
   140	  have hx := (mem_twistSubmodule_iff R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
   141	    (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a) x.1.1).mp x.1.2
   142	  rcases p with i | i <;> rcases q with j | j
   143	  · -- chart 0 / chart 0: the twisting unit is `1`
   144	    have hovl : ((A.thetaOvlUnit a (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j) :
   145	        Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inl i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl j))ˣ) :
   146	        Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inl i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl j))) = 1 := rfl
   147	    rw [hovl, map_one, one_mul]
   148	    simp only [vanishingSide_inl, Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   149	  · -- chart 0 / chart 1: the theta matching of the pair
   150	    have key := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom
   151	      (le_inf (le_inf le_top ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans
   152	          (A.pieces_inl_le i))) (inf_le_right.trans (A.pieces_inr_le j)) :
   153	        (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j) : (relCurve C R).Opens)
   154	          ≤ ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   155	            (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)) hx
   156	    rw [map_mul] at key
   157	    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key
   158	    have hovl : ((A.thetaOvlUnit a (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr j) :
   159	        Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inl i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j))ˣ) :
   160	        Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inl i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j)))
   161	        = (relCurve C R).resHom
   162	            (inf_le_inf (A.pieces_inl_le i) (A.pieces_inr_le j))
   163	            ((relThetaCocycle C R π a :
   164	              Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   165	                (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)ˣ) :
   166	              Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   167	                (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)) := rfl
   168	    rw [hovl]
   169	    simp only [vanishingSide_inl, vanishingSide_inr, Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   170	    exact key
   171	  · -- chart 1 / chart 0: the inverse theta matching
   172	    have key := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom
   173	      (le_inf (le_inf le_top (inf_le_right.trans (A.pieces_inl_le j)))
   174	          ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (A.pieces_inr_le i)) :
   175	        (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl j) : (relCurve C R).Opens)
   176	          ≤ ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   177	            (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)) hx
   178	    rw [map_mul] at key
   179	    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key
   180	    -- the inverse cocycle cancels against the cocycle
   181	    have hcancel := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom
   182	      (le_inf (inf_le_right.trans (A.pieces_inl_le j))
   183	          ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (A.pieces_inr_le i)) :
   184	        (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl j) : (relCurve C R).Opens)
   185	          ≤ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   186	            (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))
   187	      (Units.inv_mul (relThetaCocycle C R π a))
   188	    rw [map_mul, map_one] at hcancel
   189	    have hovl : ((A.thetaOvlUnit a (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inl j) :
   190	        Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inr i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl j))ˣ) :
   191	        Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inr i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl j)))
   192	        = (relCurve C R).resHom
   193	            (le_inf (inf_le_right.trans (A.pieces_inl_le j))
   194	              (inf_le_left.trans (A.pieces_inr_le i)))
   195	            (((relThetaCocycle C R π a)⁻¹ :
   196	              Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   197	                (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)ˣ).val) := rfl
   198	    rw [hovl]
   199	    simp only [vanishingSide_inl, vanishingSide_inr, Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   200	    linear_combination (- (relCurve C R).resHom
   201	        (le_inf (inf_le_right.trans (A.pieces_inl_le j))
   202	          ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (A.pieces_inr_le i)) :
   203	          (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl j) : (relCurve C R).Opens)
   204	            ≤ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   205	              (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
   206	        (((relThetaCocycle C R π a)⁻¹ :
   207	          Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   208	            (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)ˣ).val)) * key
   209	      - (relCurve C R).resHom
   210	          (le_inf le_top ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans
   211	            (A.pieces_inr_le i)) :
   212	            (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl j) : (relCurve C R).Opens)
   213	              ≤ ⊤ ⊓ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁) x.1.1.2 * hcancel
   214	  · -- chart 1 / chart 1: the twisting unit is `1`
   215	    have hovl : ((A.thetaOvlUnit a (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inr j) :
   216	        Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inr i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j))ˣ) :
   217	        Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inr i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j))) = 1 := rfl
   218	    rw [hovl, map_one, one_mul]
   219	    simp only [vanishingSide_inr, Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   220	
   221	variable (A a) in
   222	/-- **The cofactor family of a vanishing pair**: on each piece, the unique cofactor of
   223	the side reading over the adaptation equation (`s = f_p · (s/f_p)` on `⊤ ⊓ D(h_p)`). -/
   224	noncomputable abbrev vanishingDiv (p : A.index) : Γ(relCurve C R, ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces p) :=
   225	  A.eqnDiv p (inf_le_right : ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces p ≤ A.pieces p) (vanishingSide A a x p)
   226	    (vanishingSide_germ_mem x p)
   227	
   228	/-- **The cofactor family matches through the theta-ideal transition units**
   229	(`u_{pq} = (f_q/f_p) · θ^{±a}`): cancelling the regular equation `f_p` reduces the
   230	matching to the side matching against the ratio law. -/
   231	lemma vanishingDiv_matching (p q : A.index) :
   232	    (relCurve C R).resHom
   233	        (inf_le_left : (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces p ⊓ A.pieces q : (relCurve C R).Opens)
   234	          ≤ ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces p) (vanishingDiv A a x p)
   235	      = (relCurve C R).resHom
   236	          (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right :
   237	            (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces p ⊓ A.pieces q : (relCurve C R).Opens)
   238	              ≤ A.pieces p ⊓ A.pieces q)
   239	          ((A.thetaIdealUnit a p q : Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces p ⊓ A.pieces q)ˣ) :
   240	            Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces p ⊓ A.pieces q))

241	        * (relCurve C R).resHom
   242	            (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right :
   243	              (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces p ⊓ A.pieces q : (relCurve C R).Opens)
   244	                ≤ ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces q) (vanishingDiv A a x q) := by
   245	  refine A.eqn_res_cancel p (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) ?_
   246	  -- `f_p · (s_p/f_p) = s_p` restricted to the double overlap
   247	  have hL := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom
   248	    (inf_le_left : (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces p ⊓ A.pieces q : (relCurve C R).Opens)
   249	      ≤ ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces p))
   250	    (A.eqn_mul_eqnDiv p inf_le_right (vanishingSide A a x p)
   251	      (vanishingSide_germ_mem x p))
   252	  -- `f_q · (s_q/f_q) = s_q` restricted to the double overlap
   253	  have hR := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom
   254	    (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right :
   255	      (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces p ⊓ A.pieces q : (relCurve C R).Opens) ≤ ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces q))
   256	    (A.eqn_mul_eqnDiv q inf_le_right (vanishingSide A a x q)
   257	      (vanishingSide_germ_mem x q))
   258	  -- the ratio law `f_p · (f_q/f_p) = f_q` restricted to the double overlap
   259	  have hratio := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom
   260	    (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right :
   261	      (⊤ ⊓ A.pieces p ⊓ A.pieces q : (relCurve C R).Opens)
   262	        ≤ A.pieces p ⊓ A.pieces q))
   263	    (A.eqn_mul_eqnRatio p q)
   264	  -- the side matching
   265	  have hside := vanishingSide_matching x p q
   266	  -- the ideal unit is the ratio unit times the twisting unit
   267	  have hunit := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom
   268	    (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right :
